headline.text: Your requests vary in detail with the stakes of the task

observations.text: For a routine test result, the user asked only to be told whether it passed.
For a high-risk migration, the user asked for failure cases and a way back before approving. In project planning, they asked to see alternatives and what is given up.
In a later self-description, the user said they don't always want short answers and want enough to judge what to do.

interpretation.text: Within these records, the amount of detail wanted may depend on whether a decision is at stake: a brief answer for a simple check, more for choices needing approval. The user's own words point to enough to judge.

structured_output.alternative: A different explanation is that the user simply wanted particular items, such as alternatives or a rollback, rather than more length. The records don't separate stakes from topic.
structured_output.limitation: These records can't show why the user asked for each thing, how the earlier omission relates to the migration request, or whether this holds beyond these contexts.
